model.player_performance: three completed seasons using SeasonPerformance = 0.5*AvgPotentialGame + 0.5*AvgGame and existing 50/33/17 floor

criticality_reference.method: mean of top 10% of positive 3Y Criticality rank points

salary_curve.above_reference: linear continuation from 50,000,000 with slope k, preserving the existing mapping architecture

interpretation: The model keeps the endogenous Top-120 cap nearly unchanged while materially reallocating salary mass.
QB salary mass falls while RB, WR and TE receive more weight according to measured Criticality.

Elite salary concentration increases even though the raw Performance-to-Dollar exponent is reduced from 2.0 to 1.5, because Criticality targets scarce elite ranks rather than rewarding raw points uniformly.
Transitions from the last positive Criticality rank to Criticality 0 remain continuous because the modifier approaches 0.75 near the boundary.
Criticality 0 means no measured marginal lineup loss at that rank, not that the player has no fantasy value; 46 zero-Criticality players remain inside the Top 120 through Performance alone.
Brandon Aubrey becomes the only K in the Top 120 and displaces Mac Jones; this is a visible but small boundary effect that should remain part of later validation.

decision_status.current: leading working model accepted by user for persistence
decision_status.next_validation: combine with rookie-contract/minimum/dead-cap economy and team-level cap simulation before final implementation
